title: 육군공병학교령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Establishment of Departments and Units)
(1) The Army Engineer School shall have the departments and units necessary to perform its duties. <Amended on Nov. 14, 2017>
(2) Matters concerning the establishment of departments under paragraph (1) and the allocation of their duties shall be determined by the Chief of Staff of the Army, and matters concerning the establishment, duties, and organization of units shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense. <Amended on Nov. 14, 2017>
